rules.explanation: Use the base form of the verb after a modal such as can, should, or must.
After do, does, or did, use the base form of the main verb.
After do, does, or did, use the base form of the main verb.
Use a plural count noun when referring to more than one item.
Use for with a duration and since with a starting point.
Do not add more to a comparative adjective that already ends in -er.
